title: The phone cannot stay off: shutdown and a charger both boot pmOS
note: Seen 2026-11-09. poweroff in pmOS boots pmOS again. The same shutdown from the EOS recovery on the phone stays off, until a charger is plugged in; then pmOS boots instead of Android-style off-mode charging (battery on screen, system off). So the hardware can stay off; pmOS or the boot chain does not. Not diagnosed. After the audio work.

title: The ADSP crashes every 13-25 s, restarting audio each time
note: Cause found 2026-11-09 by tracing every request the ADSP makes (a verbose hexagonrpcd build on the phone): the sensors service (hexagonrpcd -s) attaches the ADSP sensor process, whose registry init re-reads the sensor configs and needs to write (temp.json); hexagonrpcd refuses all writes, the firmware asserts (SNS_REG_INIT) and the whole ADSP restarts, taking audio with it. No registry state fixes it (packaged, or the phone own from persist, readable, with the version marker - which hexagonrpcd also never serves: a real gap, patch drafted). Fix in place on the phone: hexagonrpcd-adsp-sensorspd masked. Result: 0 ADSP crashes across three boots and many minutes, the POCO X3 sound card up at about 12 s, playback without crashes. Trade-off: no ADSP sensors, which did not work anyway. Next: propose upstream (do not start sensorspd on surya until registry writes are supported; serve sns_reg_version in hexagonrpcd); see sensors-registry-writes.

title: WCD937x device tree: drop aoncc, clock the VA macro from q6afecc
note: The boot hang (RCU stalls) with the WCD937x patch is the aoncc clock controller at 0x03380000, an SM8250 address with nothing near it in the SM7150 tree: with only aoncc disabled the phone boots (2026-11-09). Without aoncc the VA macro has no mclk, so the macros, SoundWire and the sound card stay deferred. Fix as SM8250 does: no aoncc, VA macro mclk from q6afecc. Audit tools and results in linux-phone-oco/surya-lab and on linux-phone-oco/linux#1.

title: ADSP sensors: let hexagonrpcd serve a writable sensor registry
note: The sensors firmware on SM7150 (surya) rebuilds its registry from the configs at start and writes temp.json beside it; hexagonrpcd refuses every write by design, and does not serve registry/../sns_reg_version either. Sensors need both: the version marker served (patch drafted against hexagonrpc v0.5.0-20) and writes to a per-device writable copy of the registry (as Android persist is writable). An upstream change to linux-msm/hexagonrpc; until then the sensors service stays off on surya.

title: One cold boot came up without audio services
note: With the sensors service off, one boot (2026-11-09) never announced the ADSP audio services, so no sound card until the ADSP was restarted by hand. Not reproduced in two further valid cold boots (audio services about 0.1-0.2 s after the ADSP, card present). Watch for it; if it recurs, check whether the in-kernel pd-mapper was loaded before the ADSP booted.

title: Upstream: tas2562 sets the I2S slot length from the sample width
note: Kernel patch on linux-phone-oco/linux branch fix/tas2562-i2s-slot-length (one commit, compiles for arm64, verified on surya as a module built from the exact v7.1_rc3 source). Send to sm7150-mainline and to ALSA upstream (alsa-devel, the TAS2562 maintainers), signed off by the user.
